changelog:
openrouter-free-responder v0.1.0

- Initial release providing zero-cost OpenRouter chat responses.
- Automatically discovers and queries the best currently free model, retrying on failures.
- Outputs a clean JSON object specifying the selected model, response, attempted models, and number of free model candidates.
- Supports system prompt guidance and simple command-line configuration.
- Requires only Python 3 and an OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.
